input_policy: Original raw C1, no intensity rewriting or spatial resampling; preserve baseline full-field Nellie broad.

strong_signal_rule.reference_pixels: All finite positive original pixels in full frame; independent of ROI, Nellie labels and C2.
strong_signal_rule.undefined_policy: Stop this isolated test and report frame if insufficient valid pixels or scale<=0; no silent threshold substitution.
strong_signal_rule.interpretation: A conservative robust intensity margin; not pure background/camera noise, no6sigma confidence/false-positive claim.

union_stage: Per original frame, default broad OR strong raw-C1 pixels, before50-frame support counting.

diagnostics.bright_region: Original block-first C1 > saved original full-frame P99 then restricted to unchanged ROI; same region for all methods; diagnostic not accuracy.
diagnostics.detail_display: Shared non-saturating high-intensity display for three block-first frames; display only, not segmentation input.

scope: This cell only, complete 2500 frames. Reclassify using original1SE ellipse, recompute TARDIS and paired time-block bootstrap. Preserve originals.

tardis.group_rule: Frozen postmin32_pointwise_label; k1 own position-SE ellipse contact; no probability filter or weighting
tardis.total_rule: Both endpoints in same group, true original adjacent frames, keep exact zero cross-frame distances
tardis.background_rule: Ordered same-frame pairs within group, remove ALL exact zero distances including self and coincident points
tardis.normalization_rule: Independently normalize pooled Total and B raw counts to unit mass on 0-3 um; no frame-wise normalization or frame equal-weighting
tardis.beta_rule: Tail least squares dot(T,B)/dot(B,B), clipped [0,1]; save raw beta
tardis.shape_rule: Signed Intra divided by signed area on all 300 bins; retain negative bins; abs(area)<=0.01 unavailable
tardis.background_compatibility_rule: Descriptive normalized tail L1/cosine and tail-bin residuals; does not validate dynamic-mask background exchangeability

bootstrap.method: Reuse identical saved paired nonoverlapping-block weights within each 250-frame stratum
bootstrap.boundary_rule: Sum only source-block-internal true adjacent pairs; never create adjacency at block joins
bootstrap.interval_interpretation: Exploratory pointwise 2.5-97.5 percentile ranges; temporal bootstrap coverage not calibrated; no p values or simultaneous-significance claims; conditional on fixed masks and labels; does not propagate segmentation/registration uncertainty

tardis.mask_agreement_title: ROI IoU between consecutive 1s support blocks
tardis.mask_diagnostic_footer: Masks are fixed within50frames. Block-boundary IoU is descriptive; background exchangeability is unvalidated.
